description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeRuntime component, testing trigger trimming, content detection, and wake word gating logic.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntimeTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of VoiceWakeRuntime features related to wake word detection and command parsing.

methods.name: trims after trigger keeps post speech
methods.description: Tests if the method correctly trims text after a trigger word.

methods.name: trims after trigger returns original when no trigger
methods.description: Ensures original text is returned if no trigger word is present.

methods.name: trims after first matching trigger
methods.description: Verifies trimming occurs correctly when multiple triggers are present.

methods.name: has content after trigger false when only trigger
methods.description: Checks that content detection returns false when only trigger word is spoken.

methods.name: has content after trigger true when speech continues
methods.description: Checks that content detection returns true when there is additional speech after trigger.

methods.name: trims after chinese trigger keeps post speech
methods.description: Tests trimming behavior with Chinese trigger words.

methods.name: trims after trigger handles width insensitive forms
methods.description: Verifies trimming works with full-width characters equivalent to standard trigger words.

methods.name: gate requires gap between trigger and command
methods.description: Tests that command gating requires a minimum gap after the trigger word.

methods.name: gate accepts gap and extracts command
methods.description: Verifies command extraction when sufficient gap exists after trigger.

methods.name: gate command text handles foreign string ranges
methods.description: Ensures command text extraction functions correctly with ranges that may differ in string encoding.
